revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready. I interchanged lines 42 and 43 so that they correspond to lines 42 and 43 of the printed edition. The numbering of the lines in the edition was established with the help of the indices. The fact that the Greek text was printed in two columns leads to confusion. Furthermore the translation in the ed.pr. is based upon translating line 41 followed by 42 and 44. Thereafter line 43 is translated. Further confusion is created by the fact that the commentary on line 42 concerns παρὰ Φλαουίου Ἡρκουλανοῦ, which according to the indices is line 43. In Select Papyri I 151 the numbering of the lines seems to indicate that παρὰ Φλαουίου Ἡρκουλανοῦ comes „after“ the rest of the text on the verso, presumably on the same line as πάτρωνος. Until an image is available I have decided to adopt the line numbering of the ed.pr. An image will assuredly provide more clarity concerning layout and whether the translation offers the key to how the text on the verso should be understood.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - See Malouta's comments. BL fine.
Vote - AcceptText - The BL correction is fine. The suggestions should be followed up by someone with access to an image of the papyrus.

Submit - Made a BL change from σταβλαρίῳ to ταβλαρίῳ, read ταβουλαρίῳ. I Could not edit the date in DDbDP (IIIspc) to the one suggested in the same BL, which however is corrected in HGV and Trismegistos. The word order on the verso is unclear since it differs between the Select Papyri and the original edition. It should be checked from a photograph (not available to us).
